work.description: Complete nocturnal Eucharistic adoration-union brief XXVIII read through its own date8706–8710. Native pages63/64 (leaves62/63) show the right column of printed43 continuing to the left column of printed44; the entire papal body is coherent. Fused marginal date at8563–8564 belongs solely to the own title/date paratext, while own later marginal summary blocks8633–8641 are separable and retained. The next distinct XXIX starts8713. No neighboring act or inverted substantive column is selected. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
